ogTitle: Bothell Tile Installation — Better Than Builder-Grade
ogDesc: We replace failing 90s tub surrounds across Bothell with fully waterproofed, flood-tested tile showers. Honest written bids, $14–$26/sq ft installed. (425) 595-1079.

roles.heroLead: Every 1990s tub surround in Bothell was built to a price, and thirty years on the grout is telling you so. Tile itself is not waterproof — the bonded membrane behind it is. We install that membrane over a pre-sloped base, run a 24-hour flood test, photograph the result, and only then open a box of tile.
roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost in Bothell, WA?
roles.costP1: Bothell tile installation lands in the $14–$26 per square foot range installed, once the tile itself, setting materials, prep and labor are all on the ticket; the labor line alone begins at $11/sq ft. Replacing a failed tub surround with real tile runs $3,200–$6,800, while a full bathroom — shower, floor and niche — usually comes in from $6,500 to $14,000.
roles.costP2: When you're comparing bids, watch the tile format, not just the tile price. A cheap mosaic sheet can out-cost an expensive large-format plank once it's installed, because the labor lives in the cuts and grout lines — a detail low bids tend to leave out.
roles.costNote: Installed pricing for Bothell, August 2026 — tile, materials and labor together. Your free on-site estimate produces the real figure, in writing.
roles.layersLead: Bottom to top, a shower is seven layers. The builder-grade surrounds failing across Bothell's 90s subdivisions usually skipped one — almost always the membrane — to shave a few hundred dollars off a house being built by the dozen.
roles.whyP1: There's no alarm for a leaking surround. Water travels through grout, saturates the backer, and only two years later do you spot a slightly soft hallway floor or a stain spreading on a downstairs ceiling. By then the repair list runs framing, subfloor, drywall — and the tile begun again from zero.
roles.whyP2: About 10% of a shower's price is the waterproofing. Bids that come in oddly low usually found their savings right there.

roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Bothell, WA?
roles.faqA1: Add up tile, setting materials, prep and labor and Bothell tile work totals $14 to $26 for the square foot; the labor piece by itself opens close to $11. Standard tub-shower surrounds occupy roughly $3,200 through $6,800, while a bathroom finished end to end — floor, shower and niche together — usually books in the $6,500–$14,000 band. If two bids diverge sharply, check the format first: mosaic sheets and oversized planks each carry a labor load an ordinary 12×12 never sees.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Bothell?
roles.faqA2: A standard alcove shower around Bothell bills between $3,200 and $6,800. Inside that figure: tear-out of the old surround, bonded waterproofing, a base with pre-slope, the tile setting, a niche and grout. Steam, benches, curbless thresholds and full-height stone all push beyond it. Roughly one dollar of every ten buys the waterproofing — the cheapest insurance the project contains.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: On every job, yes — it's precisely what separates us from the builder-grade surround being torn out. The base gets pre-sloped to the drain; a liquid or sheet membrane climbs to full wall height; corners, seams and pipe fittings all get sealed; then comes 24 hours of flood testing, photographed for the file, before setting starts. ANSI A118.10 membranes handle the waterproofing — tile and grout never have.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: Bothell bathrooms generally need four to six working days. The first goes to demolition behind dust protection; the second belongs to substrate work plus waterproofing, and the 24-hour flood test follows straight after; setting fills a day or two more; the finish day covers grout, silicone and trim. Grout then needs a 24-hour cure before anyone showers. A floor on its own is typically a one-or-two-day affair.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: Porcelain for floors, showers and wet areas; ceramic where the job is easier. Porcelain is the denser material — water absorption under 0.5% — and it shrugs off impacts that chip ceramic. Ceramic's advantage is cost, which makes it sensible on walls and backsplashes. If a bid specs ceramic on a shower floor to hit a price, that's worth asking about.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Yes, and it's the upgrade Bothell homeowners most often add mid-quote. Installed cost runs $11 to $16 per square foot with the thermostat counted. The mat goes over an uncoupling membrane, is resistance-tested both before and after setting, and takes its own dedicated circuit. It only makes financial sense while the floor is open, so decide before tile day, not after.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: More often than not, yes — this is where careful bids part ways with cheap ones. Around $3.50 per square foot covers tear-out and haul-away, and stripping the floor exposes the subfloor, so rot, movement and door-height conflicts surface early. A flat, sound, well-bonded old floor can technically take new tile on top, but the height rises and the problems stay hidden. Surprises belong to demo day, not year two.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Bothell?
roles.faqA8: In Bothell, a standard 30 square foot kitchen backsplash installs for $1,100 to $2,200, with outlet cuts, edge trim and color-matched grout in the price. What pushes a job toward the high end is cutting and layout time — herringbone, mosaic sheets, a framed detail behind the range, or full-height slab-look porcelain. Simple running bond stays near the low end.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Ask before you accept any full re-tile bid — repair is often enough. Priced from $8 for each square foot, repair-and-regrout work takes care of stained or crumbling grout, the odd impact crack, and corners where silicone should replace grout. Where it can't help: hollow-sounding tile, tiles releasing in a spreading pattern, or a wall that flexes — that substrate has failed, and a patch buys months only. We'll tell you which situation you're in before quoting either way.
roles.faqQ10: Which Bothell neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: Both sides of Bothell's county line — Canyon Park, Downtown, North Creek, Thrashers Corner, Norway Hill, Fitzgerald, Shelton View, Westhill, Maywood Hills, Waynita, Queensgate and Bloomberg Hill — along with Kenmore, Woodinville, Mill Creek and Brier on the Northshore side.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: OC Flooring backs its tile with 2 years of workmanship coverage — set deliberately above our carpet term because tile flaws surface late: year two, not week two. Add a manufacturer's complete waterproofing assembly and that warranty layers over ours. Photos of your membrane and flood test come with the job — paperwork a builder-grade bathroom never gets.
